label: Diffuse
blurb: Photoshop's Diffuse: shuffles each pixel with one a short random step away, so edges dissolve into a grainy, frosted softness without blurring. Darken only lets only darker pixels move in, Lighten only only lighter ones; Anisotropic shuffles each pixel with the neighbour closest in colour, which softens texture while edges hold. Shimmer re-rolls the shuffle every frame, like heat or film grain crawling; the seed picks the pattern when it holds still.
